defects.claim: Slight recline against the chair back
defects.evidence: Torso flexion -67° from vertical (geometry): head z=-0.803 vs hips z=-0.084 = 0.72 units back-recline. globalTilt:-45 + spine:-22 combine to ~67° backward lean, far exceeding the description word SLIGHT. VLM side-view classified as moderately reclined (30-45°) which still exceeds slight. PR-v6 auto-fix increased globalTilt from -35 to -45 to fix recline_missing flag — over-applied magnitude. Arms overhead (L 148°, R 164° abduction) correctly match the arms-overhead claim.

failing_tests.name: torso_should_be_slight_recline
failing_tests.assert: anatomy.torso.flexion_deg > -30 AND anatomy.torso.flexion_deg < -5 (slight back arch, not deep recline)

regression_risk: Medium — changes 2 field magnitudes; leg effective world positions will shift (thighs become more horizontal-forward instead of down-forward). Sweep torso_back check still passes (torso flexion stays negative). Re-render verification recommended to confirm visual matches slight-recline intent.
rationale: Description says SLIGHT recline against chair back (i.e., spine relaxing against chair back while seated upright). PR-v6 over-applied globalTilt (-35→-45) producing 67° total recline (deep, not slight). Reduce globalTilt -45→-10 (slight overall lean back, preserves non-zero value to satisfy sweep reclining check) and spine -22→-12 (slight back arch against chair back). Total expected post-fix recline ~22° = slight. Arms overhead preserved (L 148°, R 164° abduction > 120° threshold). Legs preserved (hip flexion 60°, knee 25-30° — extended in front). Sign convention verified: spine - = backward arch; globalTilt - = supine/reclined back.
